entries.name: Standard
entries.negative: worst quality, low quality, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, signature, watermark
entries.notes: Balanced default. Positive follows the Illustrious/NoobAI tier tags; the negative is the usual short base.

entries.name: Very Aesthetic
entries.positive: masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, newest, absurdres
entries.negative: worst quality, low quality, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, signature, watermark, jpeg artifacts
entries.notes: 'very aesthetic' is honoured by NoobAI-style finetunes; plain Illustrious mostly ignores it.

entries.name: Detailed
entries.positive: masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres, highly detailed
entries.negative: worst quality, low quality, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, signature, watermark, blurry
entries.notes: More detail pressure; can over-busy simple scenes.

entries.name: Lean (fewest tokens)
entries.notes: Minimal tags for when the prompt itself is already long.

entries.name: Positive Only
entries.notes: No negative at all. Pair with a Negative Bundle if you want selective suppression.
